name: FindNearestPoint
formula: =LAMBDA(queryX,queryY,xCoords,yCoords,pointNames,LET(distArr, MAP(xCoords, yCoords, LAMBDA(x,y, {ref}Dist(queryX, queryY, x, y))), minDist, MIN(distArr), CHOOSEROWS(pointNames, XMATCH(minDist, distArr, 0))))
comment: Returns the name of the point (from `pointNames`) closest to `(queryX, queryY)` among points defined by `xCoords` and `yCoords`, using Euclidean distance via [[Dist]]. Handles empty/mismatched arrays with NA().
